git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(spec): reconcile Update divergence text with the ethos-fhns fix

The ethos-fhns fix landed on this branch: Store.Update (store.go:
878-946) now refuses an on-disk terminal mission the same way its six
siblings do (onDisk.Status != StatusOpen, store.go:914-916, pinned by
TestStore_Update_CannotReopenClosedMission). The spec's
disclosed-divergence text, written before that fix landed, had gone
stale and now overstated the gap in three places -- claiming Update
"carries no status = stOpen guard at all" and "will persist" a
caller-forged reopen, and citing the now-superseded store.go:873-932
range.

Reworded all three locations (Operations section disclosed-divergence
paragraph, the Non-goals bullet, and the TerminalIsFinal theorem
entry) to state the guard is now asymmetric rather than absent:
TerminalIsFinal holds for Update in the terminal->stOpen direction
(ethos-fhns); the narrower divergence that remains is stOpen->terminal
via Update, where a caller can still forge Status directly to a
terminal value past Close's result gate and Abandon's blocking-
delegation gate (filed as bead ethos-w1ii). Update stays excluded from
the modelled operation set for that one-sided gap, not for lacking a
guard outright.

Verified: fuzz 0 errors, ProB model_check unchanged (373 states, 989
transitions, matching the Tool run table -- prose-only change), two
pdflatex -halt-on-error passes compile cleanly with no undefined
references, make check green. Only docs/spec-mission-lifecycle.tex
touched.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <[redacted-email]>
EOF
)"
